verdict.rationale: Porkbun's docs say the API can check domain availability and pricing across hundreds of TLDs with no authentication required, so tooling can read current per-TLD prices directly. The registration dry-run also runs a price-match check before any charge, confirming prices are exposed and validated programmatically. missing for 10: explicit evidence that the response breaks out registration vs. renewal vs. transfer prices per TLD, a documented response schema for the pricing endpoint (no OpenAPI spec found), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the pricing feed.
